name: PrefixStream S3b: a landing that holds still on a Last guide, then continue

boxes.prompt:
integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic. Medium close-up, static camera. A sunlit kitchen in the morning; she stands behind a wooden counter with a bowl of lemons, window light from the left. The woman (S1), a woman in her thirties with shoulder-length dark hair, a green knit sweater and small gold earrings, speaking warmly to camera in a calm, conversational tone, says: <d>[English] Good morning. Today I want to show you how I make my grandmother's lemon cake.</d> She finishes the sentence, stops talking and holds perfectly still, looking at camera with a soft smile, for the last two seconds.

overall_soundscape: Her clear voice close to the microphone, soft kitchen room tone, a faint clock ticking.
